entities.name: Sign Pollution
entities.description: Concerns related to the visual pollution caused by excessive or large signage, including billboards and oversized signs, impacting city aesthetics and environment.

entities.name: Signage Importance
entities.description: The significance of signage in identifying buildings, especially in commercial real estate, and its role in navigation, marketing, and city identity.

entities.name: Sign Size and Impact
entities.description: The effects of sign size on visibility, city aesthetics, and pollution, including discussions on reducing sign dimensions to mitigate visual clutter.
